disposition_reason: Macro and trace elements including arsenic, cadmium, mercury and lead were quantified in fruit bodies of 13 cultivated and 4 wild-growing edible mushroom species bought in trade or at roadsides.

study.design: market survey comparing 13 cultivated mushroom species from trade and 4 wild species sold at roadsides
study.origin: cultivated: China, Poland, Netherlands, Italy, Lithuania and others (Table 1); wild: Polish forests
study.market: cultivated: shops in Poland, Norway, Germany, Italy, Netherlands, Belgium, Lithuania, China, North Korea, USA; wild: roadside sellers along Polish national routes
study.method: microwave HNO3 digestion; 68 elements by ICP-OES (Agilent 5110)
study.lod_text: 0.01-0.09 mg/kg dry weight for all elements (Table S1, not available)
study.qa: CRMs NCSDC 73349, S-1 loess soil, NIST 2709 soil, recoveries 80-120% for most elements; standard addition for others; expanded uncertainty 20%
